title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Based LLM Evaluation For Protocol State Machine Inference With Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of LLMs (specifically Llama-3 and Gemma) for network protocol state machine inference and packet seed generation.
